page_title: BHA 1-1 NEW | Brighton v Newcastle 04/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+9' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
90+7' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) will be replaced by Sven Botman.
90+7' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) as he is replaced by Emil Krafth.
90+7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing.

90+6' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the roof of the net. Bart Verbruggen is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. It will be a corner kick for Newcastle.

90+5' Diego Gomez (Brighton) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
90+4' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Brajan Gruda (Brighton) replaces Matt O'Riley.
90+4' The substitution is prepared. Diego Gomez (Brighton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yankuba Minteh.
90+3' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+3' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+2' Neat passing move from Newcastle in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 1 Goal! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Bart Verbruggen into the bottom left corner.
89' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
88' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
87' Referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
87' That looked a certain handball by Yasin Ayari (Brighton) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
85' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall.
85' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) makes a slide tackle, but referee Craig Pawson blows for a foul. Newcastle are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
83' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
81' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
80' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Brighton for a penalty. Play continues.
80' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
79' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and it's Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
76' Shots on target – 1:3.
74' Substitution. Joe Willock walks off the pitch and Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) comes on as a substitute.
73' The Newcastle players are stunned as referee Craig Pawson changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
72' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
72' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Newcastle using VAR. Let's see what happens.
71' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) trips an opposition player and Craig Pawson signals a foul. It's a penalty to Newcastle! Let's see who's going to take it.
69' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joel Veltman (Brighton) replacing Simon Adingra.
69' Here comes a substitution. Yasin Ayari (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for Jack Hinshelwood.
68' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
66' 2:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.
64' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) hammers the ball towards the roof of the net, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Bart Verbruggen, who denies him with a terrific save.
62' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
61' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) as his effort only hit the wall. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
59' A clumsy foul by Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) and Craig Pawson blows his whistle. Newcastle are awarded the free kick.
56' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jacob Murphy walks off the pitch to be replaced by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd).
54' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to substitute Mats Wieffer and he is replaced by Tariq Lamptey (Brighton).
53' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.

51' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Craig Pawson with no other option than to blow for a foul. Newcastle have a free kick.
49' Brighton are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
47' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. It's a throw-in for Newcastle.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' The Brighton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
41' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for a foul. Craig Pawson had a clear view and blows his whistle.
39' The game is interrupted. Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
38' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

37' A neat pass is well received by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
35' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Newcastle, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mats Wieffer (Brighton) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

28' 1 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the left side of the goal and makes it 1:0. Nick Pope was helpless.

25' The opposition can't get near Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just over the bar at the last second. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
24' The percentage of ball possession is – 50:50.
22' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
20' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) plays a through ball but overhits it.
19' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
16' Newcastle keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
14' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a chip pass into the box, but Bart Verbruggen is quickest to intercept the ball.
12' The corner kick from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

12' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Newcastle.

9' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears. The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a throw-in.
8' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
7' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
6' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
4' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
3' Brighton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Craig Pawson will officiate today.
